author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0045261 proton-transporting ATP synthase complex, catalytic core F(1)
GO:0045263 proton-transporting ATP synthase complex, coupling factor F(o)
GO:0045267 proton-transporting ATP synthase, catalytic core
GO:0045269 proton-transporting ATP synthase, central stalk
GO:0045265 proton-transporting ATP synthase, stator stalk
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29067

These represent subcomplexes that do not perform a distinct function. Shall be merged with GO:0045259 proton-transporting ATP synthase complex.

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KV42nyEm3t9vv8SiawU1RBw7ZlfFD1CY0eaLSHsnP6k/edit?gid=0#gid=0

@valwood

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv

title: Review annotations to descendant terms of proton-transporting ATP synthase complex

author: sarach06
body:
Hi,
Thank you very much for this. I have checked the mappings for GO:0045261 and GO:0045263 and replaced them with  GO:0045259 (there were 22 InterPro entries in total). These changes will be available in the next InterPro release (104.0).

Best,
Sara

author: raymond91125
source_title: Obsoletion notice: Proton-transporting ATP synthase complex terms (with replacement)
